region: Global, equal-weighted mean of northern and southern hemisphere anomaly series
coverage_correlation_assumption: Analysis ensemble uncertainty and additional coverage uncertainty combined in quadrature as in Morice et al. 2021 supporting information, Text S4 equation 28.
pairing_scope: The comparison of 2023 and 2024 includes only the uncertainty represented by the ensemble. No total interval for the difference is claimed.
